hypothesis: A profile frozen from whole training runs and limited to a 3 dB or 6 dB per-bin boost will increase payload-weighted lower-tail effective SINR or BICM GMI on independent flat-waveform captures by compensating the stable smooth component of the Mac-left-speaker to Pixel-7a transfer function.

incumbent.speaker: Mac built-in output channel 0 only; channel 1 is zero

retained_corpus.locator_note: Paths identify the local retained corpus. The analysis also accepts --corpus-root and verifies dry-run manifest hashes and run structure, so paths are not treated as stable public identifiers.

development_campaign.geometry: Pixel 7a face-up on 0.5-inch soft cloth above the MacBook left function key; bottom microphone near the MacBook built-in left speaker; MacBook built-in left speaker only; A/C enabled but thermostat-cycling and uninstrumented; SPL uninstrumented

microphones.route_description: builtin_mic_1; address bottom; direct channel mapping
builtin_mic_2; address back; direct channel mapping

whole_run_split.rationale: Each subset is balanced between candidate-first and candidate-second arms; no frame, microphone, or block from a held-out pair is used to fit, smooth, regularize, or select a profile.

external_stability_campaign.use: external stability evaluation only after the development profile and all thresholds are frozen

known_limitations: All retained development and external-stability arms use one nominal near-field pose; they are temporal/HVAC repeats, not the three preregistered small placement offsets required by ROADMAP Spike 8a.
Every retained OTA waveform is flat. Candidate pre-equalized received PCM and candidate byte/block outcomes do not exist.
No retained calibrated SPL, LAeq, LCpeak, THD, intermodulation, or protection-DSP measurement is available.
The corpus supports a causal profile-selection split and a linear counterfactual replay screen, but cannot by itself support OTA promotion or an acoustic-safety/nonlinearity claim.

candidate_family.occupied_bins: exact incumbent occupied-bin set recovered from retained flat TX

smooth_magnitude_minimum_phase.channel_statistic: per-bin median log magnitude across both microphones and all five frames of fit pairs after timing/CFO/common-phase alignment
smooth_magnitude_minimum_phase.smoothing: fixed 41-bin reflected Hann kernel in log magnitude
smooth_magnitude_minimum_phase.regularization: Tikhonov inverse, with lambda selected only on fit pairs from the fixed grid [0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3] times median occupied-bin power
smooth_magnitude_minimum_phase.phase: minimum phase reconstructed by real-cepstrum spectral factorization from the smoothed bounded magnitude

fixed_route_complex_inverse_oracle.status: descriptive oracle only; never the selected deployable profile
fixed_route_complex_inverse_oracle.form: conjugate(H)/(abs(H)^2 + lambda), with the same regularization grid and boost caps
fixed_route_complex_inverse_oracle.phase_legitimacy_gate: after removal of a fitted bulk linear phase per run, at least 80% of payload bins must have inter-run vector coherence >= 0.90 and circular phase standard deviation <= 20 degrees on both microphones; otherwise the oracle is not evaluated

normalization_classes.primary: equal full-waveform sample peak to the retained flat incumbent peak; no clipping
normalization_classes.diagnostic: matched active-waveform RMS; report required peak and mark any peak above the incumbent as non-comparable rather than clipping

candidate_family.profile_selection: Select one smooth candidate using fit-pair aggregate p10 BICM-GMI, breaking ties by lower inversion gain, then lower crest factor, then the 3 dB cap. Freeze it before reading held-out result.json outcomes or evaluating held-out metrics.

counterfactual_model.allowed: Apply the frozen transmit weights to a per-frame channel estimated only from known sync/pilot observations and add the retained residual/noise realization. Candidate selection cannot inspect held-out payload values, expected bytes, CRC, or blocks_ok.
counterfactual_model.evaluation_only_known_data: Expected transmitted QAM symbols may be recovered from retained TX for held-out GMI scoring only after the candidate is frozen.
counterfactual_model.forbidden_claim: Linear replay is not evidence that the physical speaker, OS dynamics/protection, room, or microphone remains linear under candidate drive.

primary.name: payload_weighted_p10_effective_sinr_db
primary.aggregation: Compute known-symbol max-log 64-QAM BICM GMI for each whole frame and microphone, map GMI monotonically to equivalent AWGN SINR, and take the payload-weighted p10 across the declared whole-run subset.
primary.comparison: frozen smooth candidate minus flat incumbent under equal sample peak

metrics.co_primary_interpretation: Report BICM GMI bits per coded bit and bits per occupied data carrier directly; equivalent SINR is a presentation mapping, not a Shannon-limit claim.
non_regression: median effective SINR must not decrease on either microphone
p10 GMI must not decrease on either microphone
full-waveform peak must not exceed the incumbent in the primary class
candidate out-of-band energy fraction may increase by no more than 0.25 dB
no non-finite samples and no digital sample clipping
secondary: crest factor and peak/RMS scale in both normalization classes
actual incumbent ordered byte/block recovery from retained results
candidate byte/block projection only if a predictor is frozen solely on fit runs and passes leave-one-fit-run-out calibration; otherwise report unavailable

decisions.advance_from_two_pair_screen: Equal-peak held-out screen gain >= 1.0 dB in aggregate p10 effective SINR, positive p10 GMI change on both microphones, and every non-regression constraint passes.
decisions.offline_confirmation_success: The independent confirmation repeats >= 1.0 dB aggregate p10 effective-SINR gain, both microphones retain nonnegative p10 GMI change, the external campaign has nonnegative aggregate p10 GMI change, and all non-regression constraints pass.
decisions.roadmap_stage_one_signal: A >= 3.0 dB aggregate held-out p10 effective-SINR gain or preregistered equivalent GMI gain is recorded as sufficient linear evidence to justify OTA testing, not as library promotion.
stop: the frozen candidate produces < 1.0 dB aggregate p10 effective-SINR gain in the two-pair screen
either microphone has negative p10 GMI change
benefit reverses on the confirmation or external campaign
the best fit candidate needs > 6 dB boost
the replay cannot recover trustworthy frame boundaries/channel/noise estimates without payload- or outcome-dependent tuning
the retained corpus cannot support the declared metric
decisions.integration: No result from this offline spike enters Sources. OTA acquisition at three small offsets, matched flat/EQ order-balanced pairs, and measured clipping/nonlinearity/protection/spectral evidence remains mandatory.

required_fields: profile weights or deterministic reconstruction parameters
artifact_schema.raw_pcm_policy: Reference retained PCM by SHA-256 and relative run path; do not duplicate large PCM into git.
